name: Instance variable
meaning: An @name stores state on the current object.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Attribute reader
meaning: attr_reader creates methods that expose instance variables without generating writers.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Method visibility
meaning: Public, protected and private determine ordinary method-call accessibility.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Singleton method
meaning: A method associated with a particular object rather than all instances of its class.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Super call
meaning: super invokes the next method implementation in the lookup chain.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Mixin
meaning: A module whose methods participate in another receiver’s method lookup.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Prepend
meaning: A mixin operation that puts module methods before the class in lookup.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Lexical constant lookup
meaning: Unqualified constant lookup depends partly on the nesting of source definitions.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Duck typing
meaning: Using an object through the behavior it supports rather than a required declared class.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Hash key equality
meaning: Hash identifies keys using consistent hash values and eql?, not merely ==.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Shallow freeze
meaning: Freezing an object does not automatically freeze the objects it references.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Data value object
meaning: Data defines immutable member bindings without enforcing deep immutability of members.
context: Ruby language and standard-library semantics; language and explicitly available core-library semantics.

name: Pattern guard
meaning: A condition that must hold after a structural pattern matches.

name: Destructuring assignment
meaning: Assigning components of a value to several local names, optionally gathering a remainder.

name: Relative require
meaning: Loading a trusted Ruby feature relative to the source file, with require’s once-per-feature behavior.

name: Public dispatch

name: Block-defined method

name: Refinement
meaning: A lexically scoped alteration to method lookup activated with using.
